parsed_response.answer: The Palghar District Strategic Plan reports an 85 km coastline, 74 fishing villages, 18,203 active fishers and 24 landing centres. Its historical fisheries production was 43,220 tonnes in 2020–21, 25,252 tonnes in 2021–22 and 43,069 tonnes in 2022–23. These are district-level historical figures, not current catch or village-level totals. Listed varieties include Pomfret, Surmai, Rohu, Katla, Bombil, Mrugal, Javla and prawns.
